blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Radiomics provides quantitative descriptions of tumour appearance that may complement disease-specific foundation models in small labelled cohorts. We investigate this complementarity for computed tomography-based classification of clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Our framework uses radiomics to modulate RenalCLIP features through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), while retaining a direct radiomics contribution. Internal testing and external validation compare it with conventional fusion strategies and reference classifiers. The FiLM model achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.804 internally and 0.854 externally, with the highest mean AUC among the evaluated RenalCLIP fusion strategies in both cohorts. Pathway ablations examine the contributions of conditional modulation and the direct radiomics residual, while feature permutation highlights the role of tumour texture. These findings support radiomics as a useful complement to RenalCLIP in a small labelled cohort and identify FiLM as an effective approach to integrating their representations for robust renal tumour classification.
blocks.zh: 放射线提供了肿瘤外观的定量描述,可以补充小标本群中特定疾病的基础模型. 我们调查这种互补作用,以计算出细胞肾脏细胞癌的分解。 我们的框架使用放射素通过特异性线性调制(FiLM)调制RenalCLIP特性,同时保留直接放射素贡献. 内部测试和外部验证将其与常规聚变策略和参考分类器进行比较. FiLM模型在接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)下实现内部0.804和外部0.854的区域,在评价的RenalCLIP聚变战略中,这两个组中的平均AUC最高。 路径冲洗检查了有条件调制和直接放射残留的贡献,而特征穿透则突出了肿瘤纹理的作用. 这些调查结果支持放射学,认为在少数被贴上标签的人群中,放射学是对RenalCLIP的有益补充,并将FiLM确定为一种有效方法,用以整合其表达方式,以便进行强健的肾脏肿瘤分类。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Preoperative characterisation of renal masses requires distinguishing tumours with overlapping imaging appearances. Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) can exhibit enhancement patterns different from those of other renal tumours, and multiphasic computed tomography (CT) measurements can assist this distinction [ 17 ] . Nevertheless, a lesion contains spatial variation in intensity and morphology that is only partly represented by conventional measurements. Computational analysis offers a means of incorporating this information into tumour classification.
blocks.zh: 肾脏质团的前期特征化需要区别肿瘤与重叠成像外观. 清细胞肾细胞癌(ccRCC)可以表现出不同于其他肾脏肿瘤的增强规律,多phasic计算成像学(CT)测量可以帮助这种区分[17]. 然而,损害包含强度和形态的空间变化,而常规测量只是部分体现这种变化。 计算分析提供了将这一信息纳入肿瘤分类的方法.

blocks.en: Radiomics characterises a segmented tumour through quantitative measurements of shape, intensity, and texture. These descriptors summarise three-dimensional geometry, intensity distributions, and spatial relationships between grey levels. They capture patterns that can be difficult to quantify consistently through visual inspection and have been investigated as markers of tumour phenotype [ 1 , 9 ] . Their explicit definitions link classifier inputs to measurable tumour properties.
blocks.zh: 放射素通过形状、强度和纹理的定量测量,将分化肿瘤定性。 这些描述符概括了三维几何,强度分布,以及灰色水平之间的空间关系. 它们捕捉出难以通过目视检查一致量化的形态,并作为肿瘤酚型[1,9]的标记被调查. 它们的明确定义将分类器输入与可测量的肿瘤性质联系起来。

blocks.en: This structured representation is particularly relevant when labelled data are limited. Its feature extractor does not require target-cohort training, and feature selection can prioritise reproducible, nonredundant measurements. Although predefined descriptors cannot encompass every aspect of tumour appearance, they provide a compact quantitative basis that may complement learned image representations [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 在贴有标签的数据有限的情况下,这种结构化的代表性尤其相关。 它的特征提取器不需要目标-曲线训练,特征选择可以优先进行可复制的,不重复的测量. 虽然预定义描述符不能包含肿瘤外观的每个方面,但它们提供了一个紧凑的量化基础,可以补充学到的图像表达[9].

blocks.en: Deep learning provides another way to represent the same image. Residual networks learn spatial filters from data [ 7 ] , while vision–language pretraining relates image appearance to associated textual information [ 11 ] . RenalCLIP applies disease-specific visual–textual learning to kidney cancer [ 13 ] . Its image representation incorporates information learned from a large pretraining cohort, but transfer to a particular histological distinction still depends on how the representation is adapted. We hypothesise that explicit radiomic descriptors can supplement RenalCLIP features when the target task has relatively few labelled examples.
blocks.zh: 深度学习提供了另一种代表相同形象的方法. 残余网络从数据中学习空间过滤器[7],而视觉-语言预训将图像外观与相关的文字信息[11]. RenalCLIP将特定疾病的视觉-文字学习应用于肾癌[13]. 其形象表现包含从大量训练前群体中汲取的信息,但向特定组织区分的转移仍取决于该表现是如何调整的。 我们假设,当目标任务贴上标签的例子相对较少时,明确的放射描述符可以补充RenalCLIP特征.

blocks.en: The way these representations interact may influence how effectively that supplementary information is used. Concatenation makes both vectors available to a common classifier. Gated fusion learns their relative weighting [ 2 ] . Feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) instead uses a conditioning input to generate an affine transformation of another representation [ 10 ] . Radiomics can therefore do more than contribute additional classifier inputs. It can guide how image features are scaled and shifted for each patient.
blocks.zh: 这些表述方式可以影响补充资料的有效使用。 协和使两种矢量都提供给普通的分类器. Gated核聚变学他们的相对权重[2]. 特异性偏导线性调制(FiLM)转而使用调制输入来生成另一个表达式的affine转换[10]. 因此,放射能够发挥更大的作用,而不是提供额外的分类输入。 它可以指导每个病人如何缩放和改变图像特性。

blocks.en: We propose a radiomics-conditioned residual FiLM framework for ccRCC classification. The model uses radiomics both to modulate RenalCLIP features and to provide a direct residual representation for the classifier. We compare this formulation with concatenation, alternative gates, and globally shared affine modulation, together with conventional radiomics and convolutional references. Internal and external evaluation assesses classification performance, while pathway ablations and radiomics permutation analysis examine how the model uses the additional quantitative information.
blocks.zh: 我们建议为CCRCC分类建立一个有放射线条件的残留纤维LM框架。 该模型既使用放射素来调制RenalCLIP特征,又为分类器提供直接的残留代表. 我们把这种配方与配方、替代大门、全球共享的配方配方以及常规放射和演化参考进行比较。 内部和外部评价评估了分类绩效,而路径积分和放射穿透分析则审查模型如何使用额外的定量信息。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Study Cohorts
blocks.zh: 2.1 学习室

blocks.en: The internal cohort comprised 396 KiTS23 patients [ 8 ] with CT, tumour masks, histological labels, and complete feature records. ccRCC was defined as the positive class and the remaining histologies as the negative class. The fixed patient-level split comprised 237 training, 99 validation, and 60 test patients, with stratification used to maintain an approximately 70% ccRCC prevalence across the three subsets. Multiple tumour delineations were combined using STAPLE consensus where available [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 内部组群包括396名KitS23患者[8],有CT,肿瘤口罩,组织标签,以及完整的特征记录. ccRCC被定义为阳性类,其余的神学被定义为阴性类. 固定的病人级别划分包括237个培训、99个鉴定和60个测试病人,分层用于维持3个子集的CCRCC流行率约70%。 利用STAPLE共识(如果有的话)结合了多种肿瘤的划定[16].

blocks.en: The external cohort combined RCC-AID data [ 4 ] with previously assembled TCGA cases using AIMI annotations [ 15 ] . After patient-level deduplication and image-quality review, 111 patients remained, comprising 85 ccRCC and 26 non-ccRCC cases (76.6% ccRCC). All methods were evaluated on the same selected CT scan and tumour mask for each patient.
blocks.zh: 外部组群将RCC-AID数据与先前利用AIMI说明汇编的TCGA案例合并[4]. 经过患者层面的分化和图像质量审查,111名患者仍保留下来,包括85例CCRCC和26例非CCRCC病例(76.6%CCRCC). 所有方法均在为每个患者选定的相同CT扫描和肿瘤口罩上进行评估。

blocks.en: 2.2 CT Processing and Feature Representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 CT处理和专题陈述

blocks.en: Radiomics.
blocks.zh: 放射线

blocks.en: CT volumes were consistently oriented, resampled to 1-mm isotropic spacing, and clipped to [ − 150,200 ] [-150,200] Hounsfield units (HU). Masks underwent nearest-neighbour resampling. Features were extracted with PyRadiomics [ 14 ] , using definitions described by the Image Biomarker Standardization Initiative [ 18 ] . Original-image shape descriptors were combined with first-order and texture features from the original and Laplacian-of-Gaussian (LoG) images. LoG scales were σ ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } \sigma\in\{1,2,3\} mm and the intensity bin width was 25 HU. Filtering preceded cropping.

Average-linkage clustering with distance 1 − | ρ | 1-|\rho| and a cut of 0.2 retained the highest-MAD feature per cluster. Median imputation and standardisation parameters were fitted on training patients and applied unchanged to subsequent datasets, producing 𝐱 ∈ ℝ 73 \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{73} .

blocks.en: RenalCLIP.
blocks.zh: 雷纳尔CLIP.

blocks.en: The public RenalCLIP image encoder [ 13 ] provided disease-specific image representations. Its pretraining data came from independent institutional cohorts in China and did not overlap with the present study datasets. The 3D ResNet18 encoder and its batch-normalisation statistics were held fixed. We pooled its third residual-stage feature map using tumour-mask weights, producing 𝐳 ∈ ℝ 256 \mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{256} after L2 normalisation. Mask voxels were distributed trilinearly to stride-aligned centres on the 2 × 8 × 8 2\times 8\times 8 feature grid. The pooled vector was the weighted mean of these features. This emphasised tumour-associated locations while retaining contextual receptive fields.
blocks.zh: 公共RenalCLIP图像编码器[13]提供了针对疾病的图像表示. 其预训数据来自中国的独立机构组群,与本研究数据集没有重叠. 3D ResNet18编码器及其批量规范化统计被固定. 我们用肿瘤-面具的重量集合了它的第三阶段特征图,在L2正常化后产生了z 256 \ mathbf{z}\in\ mathbb{R}^{256}. Mask voxels在2×8 ×8 2\times 8 特性网格上被三线分配到步态中心. 集合矢量是这些特征的加权平均值。 这种强调与肿瘤有关的地点,同时保留上下文的可接受领域。

blocks.en: An 87.5 × 87.5 × 100 87.5\times 87.5\times 100 mm field of view was centred on the tumour centroid in the axial slice with the largest tumour area. Trilinear sampling produced 140 × 140 × 32 140\times 140\times 32 voxels, followed by a 128 × 128 × 32 128\times 128\times 32 centre crop, giving a final 80 × 80 × 100 80\times 80\times 100 mm field of view. Windowing at centre 50 HU and width 500 HU mapped intensities to [0,1]. The same processing was applied across cohorts.
blocks.zh: 87.5×87.5×100 87.5×时 87.5×时100毫米视场以轴心切片中肿瘤中间体为中心,肿瘤面积最大. 三线采样生产出140×140×32次140×次140×次40×次32伏牛,其次是128×128×32×128×次32中心作物,给出了最终的80×80×10080×80×80×100毫米视场. 中心窗口为50HU,宽度为500HU,将强度映射为[0]. 对各组人也采用了同样的处理方法。

blocks.en: 2.4 Comparison Methods
blocks.zh: 2.4 比较方法

blocks.en: A radiomics-based radial-basis-function support-vector classifier (SVC) [ 3 ] served as the conventional reference. Convolutional comparisons comprised a 3D ResNet18 trained from scratch, together with its radiomics-gated and radiomics-FiLM variants. These models used normalised 128 3 128^{3} tumour-centred CT inputs and 512-dimensional ResNet18 representations for fusion.
blocks.zh: 一个以射线为基础的射线-基准-功能-飞行器分类器(SVC)[3]作为常规参考. 转录比较包括从零开始训练的3D ResNet18及其放射成型和放射成型的FILM变体。 这些模型使用了常态化的128 3 128^{3}以肿瘤为中心的CT输入和512维的ResNet18表示用于聚变.

blocks.en: 2.5 Training and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.5 培训和评价

blocks.en: RenalCLIP-based classifiers were optimised with cross-entropy and AdamW at learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , with batch size 16 and zero weight decay. Dropout of 0.2 was used in the 128-dimensional projections and image-only classifier. The concatenation classifier used no dropout. Convolutional references used class-weighted cross-entropy and Adam at learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} with mixed precision. Their training augmentation included spatial flips, rotations, and affine perturbations. Models were selected according to internal validation AUC and applied to the test and external cohorts without further fitting.
blocks.zh: 以RenalCLIP为基础的分类器被优化为横切和AdamW,学习率10−3 10−3},批量大小16,零重量衰减. 0.2的退学被用于128维的投影和仅图像分类器. 协和分类器没有使用退出。 革命参考文献以10 -4 10 -4 4 的学习速度,使用阶级加权的交叉进取和亚当的精确度有好有坏。 他们的训练增强包括空间翻转、旋转和近缘扰动。 模型根据内部验证AUC进行选择,并应用于测试组和外部组别,没有进一步安装.

blocks.en: The primary metric was AUC, with average precision (AP) as a complementary measure. RenalCLIP-based methods were evaluated over three independent training runs. The SVC and convolutional references each used one trained model. Internal results report mean and sample standard deviation (SD) for repeated runs and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for single-model references. External results report patient-bootstrap CIs. Each bootstrap sample preserved class counts and the correspondence of predictions across runs. For methods with repeated training, metrics were calculated separately and then averaged. CIs used 2,000 resamples [ 5 ] and quantify patient-sampling uncertainty for the fitted models.
blocks.zh: 主要衡量标准是AUC,作为补充衡量标准,平均精确度(AP)。 对基于RenalCLIP的方法进行了三次独立培训评估。 SVC和革命参考文献都使用了一个训练有素的模型. 内部结果报告对重复运行的标准偏差(SD)和对单模型参考的95%的置信间隔(CIS)进行表示和抽样. 外部结果报告患者-诱饵感染者。 每个靴子样本都保留了类数和预测的对应性。 对于经过反复培训的方法,衡量标准分别计算,然后平均计算。 CIS使用2000个复标[5],并量化了装配模型的病人样本不确定性.

blocks.en: 2.6 Pathway Ablations and Feature Permutation
blocks.zh: 2.6 路径障碍和特征

blocks.en: Two inference-time ablations examined the radiomics pathways in the fitted FiLM model. Removing the direct residual gives 𝐡 no ​ direct = 𝐡 − 𝐫 / 2 \mathbf{h}_{\mathrm{no\ direct}}=\mathbf{h}-\mathbf{r}/2 , preserving conditional modulation. Disabling modulation gives 𝐡 no ​ modulation = ( 𝐢 + 𝐫 ) / 2 \mathbf{h}_{\mathrm{no\ modulation}}=(\mathbf{i}+\mathbf{r})/2 , preserving the projected representations. All other weights were held fixed.
blocks.zh: 两次推断时间模拟检查了装配的FiLM模型中的放射道。 清除直接残基时给出h没有直接=h − r / 2\ mathbf{h}_{\mathrm{no\ direct}}=\mathbf{h}-\mathbf{r}/2,保留有条件的调制. 禁用调制令 h no moduction = (i + r ) / 2\ mathbf{h}_{\ mathrm{no\ moduction }}=(\mathbf{i}+\ mathbf{r})/2,保留了预测的表示. 所有其他重量被固定。

blocks.en: For feature importance, each radiomics descriptor was independently permuted across internal-test patients 50 times [ 6 ] . The same permutations were used across training runs. The radiomics projection and modulation parameters were recomputed after each permutation. Importance was defined as the decrease in AUC, averaged first across permutations and then across runs.
blocks.zh: 就特征重要性而言,每个放射线描述器在内部测试患者中独立渗透50倍[6]. 在整个培训中采用了同样的模式。 放射线投影和调制参数在每次演化后重新计算. 重要性的定义是AUC的下降,平均先是各层,然后是各层。

blocks.en: 3 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 3.1 Internal Classification Performance
blocks.zh: 3.1 内部分类业绩

blocks.en: FiLM achieved the highest mean internal AUC among the evaluated RenalCLIP fusion strategies, reaching 0.804 (Table 1 ) and improving on RenalCLIP alone by approximately 9.8 percentage points. Global affine modulation achieved the next highest mean AUC, followed by the gated and concatenation approaches. The consistent improvement of the fusion approaches over the image-only classifier supports supplementing transferred features with radiomics.
blocks.zh: FiLM在经过评价的RenalCLIP聚变战略中实现了最高平均内部AUC,达到0.804(表1),仅RenalCLIP就提高了约9.8个百分点. 全球芳香调制实现了第二高的平均值AUC,其次是门化和调制方法. 与图像唯一分类器相比,聚变方法的不断改进支持用放射学来补充转移的特性.

blocks.en: Table 1: Internal-test performance. RenalCLIP methods report three-run mean ± \pm SD. Single-model references report 95% CIs. All fusion methods include radiomics. Ablations use the fitted FiLM models.
blocks.zh: 表1:内部测试性能。 RenalCLIP方法报告3运行 ±\pm SD. 单型参考报告为95%的CI. 所有聚变方法包括放射. 缩写使用装配的FiLM模型.

blocks.en: The similar internal performance of global affine modulation and FiLM indicates that a shared transformation also captured useful relationships between the representations. SVC remained competitive and achieved the highest internal AP, highlighting the discriminatory information already present in radiomics. Within the convolutional comparisons, gating performed better than FiLM. The benefit of a fusion strategy therefore depended on the representation and learning configuration.
blocks.zh: 全球芳香调制和FiLM类似的内部性能表明,共同的转变也抓住了代表之间有益的关系. SVC仍然具有竞争力,并实现了最高的内部AP,突出显示辐射中已经存在的歧视性信息. 在进化的比较中,吉丁的表现优于FiLM. 因此,聚变战略的好处取决于代表性和学习结构。

blocks.en: 3.2 External Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 外部评价

blocks.en: FiLM achieved the highest mean external AUC among the evaluated RenalCLIP fusion strategies, reaching 0.854 (Table 2 ). This exceeded the image-only classifier by 9.86 percentage points. SVC retained a slightly higher AUC, whereas FiLM achieved a higher AP than SVC.
blocks.zh: FiLM在经过评价的RenalCLIP聚变战略中实现了最高的外部平均AUC,达到0.854(表2). 这超过了仅图像分类器9.86个百分点. SVC保留了略高的AUC,而FiLM实现了比SVC更高的AP.

blocks.en: Table 2: External performance on 111 patients. Brackets denote 95% patient-bootstrap CIs. For methods with three training runs, the point estimate and each bootstrap replicate are means of individual-model metrics.
blocks.zh: 表2:111名病人的外部表现。 Brackets表示95%的患者-bootstrap CIs. 对于进行三次训练的方法,点数估计和每套靴子复制是个人模型衡量手段。

blocks.en: FiLM achieved the highest mean AUC in both the internal and external RenalCLIP fusion comparisons, although the margins over global affine modulation internally and concatenation externally were small. Radiomics provided a consistent improvement across cohorts, with the integration strategy contributing a smaller additional effect.
blocks.zh: FiLM在国内外RenalCLIP聚变比较中实现了最高的平均值AUC,尽管相对于全球芳香调制内部和外部调制的幅度很小. 放射病使各组别的情况持续改善,融合战略产生了较小的额外效果。

blocks.en: 3.3 Pathway Ablations
blocks.zh: 3.3 路径障碍

blocks.en: Removing the direct radiomics residual and disabling conditional modulation reduced mean internal AUC by 0.79 and 0.22 percentage points, respectively (Table 1 ). Both pathways contributed numerically to the fitted model, with a larger change after removing the direct residual. Retaining modulation allowed radiomics to influence predictions indirectly, while retaining the residual preserved its explicit contribution.
blocks.zh: 消除直接放射性残留和失效的有条件调制,将AUC内部的平均值分别减少0.79和0.22个百分点(表1)。 这两种途径在数字上都有助于安装模型,在清除直接残余物后,变化更大。 保留调制可以使放射线间接影响预测,同时保留剩余部分保留其明确贡献.

blocks.en: The effects were modest and indicate overlapping information routes. Additive modulation can itself carry radiomics information, partly compensating for removal of the direct residual. These ablations describe dependence within the fitted model, rather than the performance of independently retrained alternatives. They support using the complete formulation without establishing that either pathway is individually indispensable.
blocks.zh: 影响不大,表明信息路线重叠。 添加调制本身可以携带放射线信息,部分补偿去除直接残留. 这些缩写描述的是装配模型中的依赖性,而不是独立再培训替代品的性能。 它们支持采用完整的表述方式,但并未确定其中任一途径都是各自不可或缺的。

blocks.en: 3.4 Radiomics Feature Importance
blocks.zh: 3.4 辐射特性

blocks.en: Texture descriptors dominated the highest-ranked permutation effects (Fig. 2 ). LoG 2-mm GLCM information measure of correlation 2, original-image GLDM dependence entropy, and LoG 1-mm zone entropy were the leading features. These descriptors quantify different aspects of spatial intensity organisation and heterogeneity. Their prominence indicates that the additional radiomics information used by the model extended beyond tumour size or a single intensity summary.
blocks.zh: 纹理描述器主导了排位最高的演化效应(图2 ). 常规 关联2的2-mm GLCM信息度量,原成像GLDM依赖 en,LoG 1-mm区 en是主要特征. 这些描述符量化了空间强度组织和异性的不同方面。 其显著性表明,模型使用的额外放射线信息超出了肿瘤大小或单一强度总结.

blocks.en: Figure 2: The ten radiomics features with the largest mean AUC decrease under permutation. Blue markers and bars show mean ± \pm SD across runs, and grey markers show individual-run means over 50 permutations. GLCM, GLRLM, GLSZM, and GLDM denote co-occurrence, run-length, size-zone, and dependence matrices. GLNU denotes grey-level nonuniformity.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 平均AUC量最大的十个放射特征在穿透量下减少。 蓝色标记和条条显示的是 ±\\pm SD 横跨运行,灰色标记显示个人运行意味着超过50个通量. GLCM、GLRLM、GLSZM和GLDM表示共同发生、运行长度、大小区和依赖性矩阵。 GLNU 表示灰度不统一.

blocks.en: Because a permuted descriptor affects both the radiomics projection and its modulation parameters, these scores reflect its contribution to the full fusion model. Correlated descriptors may share predictive information, so a small individual permutation effect does not imply that the corresponding image property is unimportant [ 6 ] . The analysis provides a quantitative account of model reliance, rather than a direct biological attribution.
blocks.zh: 由于一个穿透的描述符既影响放射线投射,也影响其调制参数,这些分数反映了其对全聚变模型的贡献. 相关描述符可能共享预测信息,因此一个小的单个穿透效应并不意味着相应的图像属性不重要[6]. 分析提供了模型依赖的定量说明,而不是直接的生物归属.

blocks.en: 3.5 Complementarity and Fusion Design
blocks.zh: 3.5 互补和融合设计

blocks.en: The central finding is that explicit radiomic descriptors supplement RenalCLIP for classification with limited labelled data. RenalCLIP reflects patterns learned through disease-specific pretraining, whereas radiomics directly supplies predefined intensity and texture measurements. This distinction provides a plausible basis for complementarity. Information implicit in a pooled image representation may become easier to exploit when an associated quantitative descriptor is supplied explicitly.
blocks.zh: 中心发现是,明显的放射描述器补充了RenalCLIP,用于分类,贴有有限标签的数据. RenalCLIP反映了通过特定疾病预训所学到的规律,而放射线直接提供预定义的强度和纹理测量. 这种区分为互补性提供了可信的基础。 如果明确提供相关的定量描述,集合图像表述中隐含的信息可能更容易利用。

blocks.en: FiLM incorporates that information through a transformation conditioned on each patient’s radiomics profile. Multiplicative modulation changes the contribution of image coordinates, while additive modulation adjusts their offsets. The direct residual preserves descriptors that are already useful for classification. Together, these mechanisms allow radiomics to contribute both explicit predictive information and context for adapting the learned representation.
blocks.zh: FiLM通过每个病人的放射特征的转化来纳入这些信息。 乘式调制会改变图像坐标的贡献,而添加式调制会调整它们的抵消. 直接残留保留了已经可用于分类的说明。 这些机制共同使放射波既能提供明确的预测信息,又能提供适应所学表现的背景。

blocks.en: FiLM achieved the highest mean AUC within the RenalCLIP fusion comparisons in both cohorts, suggesting that patient-specific conditioning can be useful for integrating the two representations. However, the competitive performance of global affine modulation, concatenation, and gated fusion shows that simpler interactions also exploit the radiomic descriptors effectively. The modest differences between fusion methods, together with the strong SVC results, indicate that radiomics supplies much of the available discriminatory information. The most directly supported complementarity is radiomics supplementing the transferred image representation, while the incremental value of conditional modulation remains modest.
blocks.zh: FiLM在RenalCLIP聚变比较中实现了两个组别中最高的平均值AUC,这表明患者的特异性调节可以用来整合两种表达. 然而,全球芳香调制,调制,加成,加成聚变的竞争性表现表明,更简单的相互作用也有效地利用了放射描述符. 聚变方法之间的微小差异以及强大的SVC结果表明,放射线提供了许多现有的歧视性信息。 最直接支持的互补性是补充转移图像表示的放射素,而有条件调制的增量值仍然不大.

blocks.en: 3.6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 3.6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The study is retrospective and the internal test cohort is relatively small. The convolutional and SVC references use single trained models, while RenalCLIP methods use repeated runs. Comparisons between frozen-feature and end-to-end approaches should be interpreted cautiously because their preprocessing and optimisation procedures differed. Larger independent cohorts and repeated training of all references would provide a more precise assessment of their relative performance. Future work should examine how conditional fusion behaves across acquisition settings and whether its effects persist under changes in segmentation and feature extraction.
blocks.zh: 该研究具有追溯性,内部测试组相对较小. 转录和SVC参考使用单一训练的模型,而RenalCLIP方法使用重复运行. 应当谨慎地解释冷冻版和端对端方法之间的比较,因为它们的预处理和优化程序不同。 较大的独立小组和对所有参考资料的反复培训将更准确地评估其相对业绩。 今后的工作应审查有条件的聚变如何在获取环境中进行,以及在分裂和特征提取的变化下其影响是否持续存在。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: Radiomics provides complementary information for RenalCLIP-based ccRCC classification in a small labelled cohort. Residual FiLM uses these descriptors to modulate image features while preserving their direct contribution. It achieved AUCs of 0.804 internally and 0.854 externally, with the highest mean AUC among the evaluated RenalCLIP fusion strategies in both cohorts. Pathway ablations indicated overlapping radiomics contributions, and permutation analysis highlighted texture descriptors. These findings support conditional modulation for integrating the representations and motivate confirmation across larger, independent cohorts.
blocks.zh: 放射素为在小的分类群中基于RenalCLIP的CCRCC分类提供了补充信息. 残余的FiLM使用这些描述符来调制图像特征,同时保留其直接贡献. 它在内部和外部分别实现了0.804和0.854的AUC,在评价的RenalCLIP聚变战略中,这两个组别的平均AUC最高。 路径淤积表明放射学的贡献相互重叠,穿透分析突出了纹理描述。 这些调查结果支持有条件的调整,以整合陈述意见,促使更多的独立群体予以确认。
